name: New Land Beyond

frame.name: The Master
frame.description:
Scoring precision hits increases this weapon's damage until the wielder's defeat.

Massively increases ammo reserves.

perks.name: Horizon Ironsights
perks.description:
Sturdy iron sights.
• Increases range.
• Slightly increases handling speed.

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Bullseye Bolster
perks.description: Landing a precision hit substantially increases this weapon's target acquisition, handling, reload speed, and stability for a short duration of time.

perks.name: Snapshot Sights
perks.description: Faster time to aim down sights.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: Every hit blazes the path to our reclamation.

catalyst.name: New Land Beyond Catalyst
catalyst.description: While this weapon is at high stacks of Master, new rounds are continually loaded into the magazine, and the benefits from Bullseye Bolster last longer.
